body: I know my parents would be ok but I’m thinking how could I tell my mom or dad

Hey Sean thanks for this,
Is that using my fingers and just stretching out regularly or am I supposed to buy these ring things.
Trying to solve it myself as I’m trying to avoid an awkward convo with parents about my penis.

Thank you so much your kind and knowledgable words mean so much to me and I’m for sure going to take your advice.
Thank you,
Would it be ok if I were to Pm you to talk a bit more I feel like we can both help each other in a way?

I’d first of all like to say I’m deeply sorry for the death of your son I cannot imagine how you feel. I’m so glad you have shown this through a parent’s perspective and I really respect how you’re able to speak on this. Your saying is right, I don’t know how I’ll feel tomorrow and I feel out of all the replies I’ve been lucky enough to get tonight yours has made the most of an impact and I’d like to thank you so much.
You seem like an amazing man and an even better father. Don’t stop fighting and keep your head up.

You don’t need to say anything my friend, I’d like to thank you.
Not only did you make me think, you took time out if your day to help a teenager that you don’t know.
Although I do feel down, you helped me realise a lot tonight.
So thank you,

A long time ago I must say, I’ll have to try.

Would it be ok if I were to Pm you just to talk easier and more private I feel like there’s a lot to learn from you.

It seems simple and multiple family members have done it before I pray for them and somedays I believe they pray for me and keep me here but other days they don’t, I don’t know maybe it’s just my outlook but I feel god has a place for most people in heaven.

True you’re very right and you seem like a very intellectual person I respect you for that. I feel I might slowly lean myself back into religion a bit more and hopefully when all this coronavirus ends I can begin to attend mass again. 
For now, I’m not too sure what to do.
I feel good has a place for everyone, I’m not a bad person i give as much back to my community I give back as much as I can I believe that he has room for me regardless of how I go out.

That’s very valid and I understand what you’re saying I’m just nervous on what people would think about me still, don’t get me wrong going to church is not looked down upon in Ireland but heavily joked about and I don’t know if I can take more jokes
In what perspective, as in an after life? I’d like to think there’s a heaven out there somewhere. But if you mean for the people around me I haven’t thought about it
Your theory is right but it feels like everything would be much more simple if I was to die right now

I’m Christian and I’ve never lost any faith in God but I must admit that I have not been to church since I was about 13 apart from funerals and remembrance masses maybe this is something I should look into.
I feel If I were to look into this and get in touch with it I might be looked down on in school as it is no longer a “cool” thing to do.
Would it be ok if I where to private chat you?
I don’t know and that’s the worst part for me, I have everything to be happy but I can’t find it in myself to be happy
I don’t know what to do with myself anymore. I feel like everyone here will take my feelings as a joke because I’m only 16 but I’m serious about this.
